name.str_pl: copies of Murdered by the Grapevine

variants.description: This cheap paperback tells the story of a mob boss done in by mere suspicion.  She never breaks a confidence, never rats out an accomplice, and never turns her back on a friend.  Nonetheless her grip on the reigns of the underworld is eroded by rumor and paranoia.

name.str_pl: copies of Come Fly the Treacherous Skies

variants.description: This tale of intrigue betrays the story of a debonair mechanic driven by a lust for revenge.  As she uncovers a sophisticated network of amateur pilots turned smugglers, the good guys and the bad guys begin to all look the same.

name.str: Lies, Damn Lies, and Rocket Science
name.str_pl: copies of Lies, Damn Lies, and Rocket Science

variants.description: This spy novel tells the story of a jaded rocket scientist looking for redemption in all the wrong places.  As selling state secrets becomes her career, she learns there isn't much of difference between a double-agent and a triple-agent.
